mapper.sql: b.id, b.material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, b.batch_no, b.production_date, b.expiry_date, b.create_time, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.qty), 0) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.material_id = b.material_id AND s.batch_no = b.batch_no) AS qty
mapper.select: SELECT FROM wms_batch b JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = b.material_id WHERE b.id = #{id}
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO wms_batch (material_id, batch_no, production_date, expiry_date, create_time, update_time) VALUES
(#{b.materialId}, #{b.batchNo}, #{b.productionDate}, #{b.expiryDate}, NOW(), NOW())
